headline: 6 Confidential Vault mainnet contracts catalogued from official docs; FHEVM infrastructure contract addresses (ACL, KMSVerifier, FHEVMExecutor), ZAMA token, and staking contracts not yet surfaced from fetched sources.
short_headline: 6 vault contracts found; infra addresses pending

findings.text: D1: Etherscan name-tag search URL was blocked (not in allowlist); search grounding returned sepolia.etherscan.io snippet for a ZamaConfig contract (0x967a0ea92af56a4c3503465cf14afcfa0492d00a on Sepolia), but mainnet name-tag results for 'zama' were not obtained from a fetchable on-chain source this run.

D2: Official deployments doc located at https://docs.zama.org/protocol/confidential-vault/reference/addresses — fetched successfully. 6 Ethereum mainnet contracts listed: DepositVaultBatcherConfidential (0x324EA89FD3784036673BfE6Ffee2334A088F40Cc), RedeemVaultBatcherConfidential (0x96Cd3Faa7483783Ac2Eb715f6333361500F1eec9), cUSDC ERC7984ERC20Wrapper (0xe978F22157048E5DB8E5d07971376e86671672B2), cShare ERC7984ERC20Wrapper (0x66Bf74E96900D1a19c7070D939D124f2F565C458), Morpho VaultV2/Steakhouse USDC (0xbEEF00A59B577423653A1526c7009bdE103F542B), WhitelistSendAssetsGate (0x47C591A3BC346913d0b6bDD96FB50E34efA268Aa). Also lists USDC (0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48) as underlying asset.

D3: No audit links were pinned in the per-protocol context. The litepaper references a 'Zama Standard Library' of 'audited, highly optimized smart contracts' but no audit PDF URLs were surfaced in fetched pages. The security page (https://www.zama.org/security) describes a responsible disclosure policy but does not link to completed audit reports.

D4: GitHub org is github.com/zama-ai. The SDK docs reference github.com/zama-ai/relayer-sdk and github.com/zama-ai/sdk. ZamaConfig.sol in github.com/zama-ai/fhevm was identified as containing mainnet FHEVM infrastructure addresses (ACL, FHEVMExecutor, KMSVerifier, InputVerifier) per search results, but the direct URL was blocked (not in prior fetch results). No commit-SHA-pinned deployment artifact was retrieved this run.

D5: Only Ethereum mainnet is in scope per protocol.chains. Sepolia staging addresses also appear in the docs addresses page but are out of scope for mainnet cataloguing. No multi-chain deployment evidence found for protocol contracts.

D6: No factory contracts surfaced in fetched pages. The WhitelistSendAssetsGate (0x47C591A3BC346913d0b6bDD96FB50E34efA268Aa) gates deposits but is not a factory. No pool/market enumeration methods identified.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to 6 mainnet addresses: DepositVaultBatcherConfidential=vault (deposit batcher), RedeemVaultBatcherConfidential=vault (redeem batcher), cUSDC=token (ERC7984 wrapped USDC), cShare=token (ERC7984 wrapped vault share), Morpho VaultV2=vault (yield source), WhitelistSendAssetsGate=other (access gate). Actor classes unknown — no on-chain reads performed for these addresses this run.

D8: All 6 admin_addresses entries trace to the fetched docs URL https://docs.zama.org/protocol/confidential-vault/reference/addresses. FHEVM infrastructure contracts (ACL, FHEVMExecutor, KMSVerifier) referenced in docs but exact mainnet addresses not retrieved from a fetched source; recorded in unknowns with D8 code.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked the official website, SDK docs, security page, and the canonical contract addresses page. 6 Ethereum mainnet Confidential Vault contracts were catalogued from the official docs. FHEVM infrastructure contracts (ACL, FHEVMExecutor, KMSVerifier), ZAMA token, staking contract, and bridge contract addresses were referenced but not retrieved from a directly fetched source; Etherscan name-tag search was blocked. Grade is unknown because the address_book is materially incomplete — infrastructure and governance addresses are unverified.

evidence.shows: Official Zama Protocol website confirming Ethereum mainnet deployment, product suite (Shield/Unshield/Send/Earn), links to app.zama.org, staking.zama.org, bridge.zama.org, GitHub (github.com/zama-ai), and docs (docs.zama.org/protocol).

Underlying asset USDC at 0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48.

Documents that Zama deploys and maintains FHEVM infrastructure contracts on Ethereum mainnet: ACL, FHEVMExecutor, KMSVerifier (InputVerifier resolved at runtime via FHEVMExecutor.getInputVerifierAddress()). Exact mainnet addresses not listed on this page — they are embedded in ZamaConfig.sol in the fhevm GitHub repo.

Zama responsible disclosure policy; security contact email security@zama.org; bug bounty program with rewards; in-scope vulnerabilities include smart contract vulnerabilities. No external bug bounty platform (Immunefi etc.) linked.

SDK overview referencing github.com/zama-ai/relayer-sdk (legacy) and github.com/zama-ai/sdk (current). Relayer URLs: https://relayer.mainnet.zama.org/v2 (requires x-api-key) and https://relayer.testnet.zama.org/v2 (open). Gateway chain IDs: mainnet 261131, testnet 10901.

protocol_metadata.about: The Zama Protocol is a confidentiality layer for public blockchains that enables encrypted smart contracts and confidential asset management using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE). Users can shield ERC-20 tokens (e.g. USDC) into encrypted ERC-7984 confidential token form, conduct private transfers with amounts hidden on-chain, and earn yield via integration with Morpho lending vaults — all without revealing balances or transaction amounts to validators or the public. The protocol's core mechanism uses symbolic execution on the host chain (Ethereum) paired with a decentralized network of FHE coprocessors and a threshold-MPC Key Management Service (KMS) for secure decryption.
